title: 10x Best Sellers Fantasi | 70/30 Shortfill Bundle
description:
Fantasi Best Selling 70/30 E-Liquid Bundle Pack:
If you’re a fan of our Fantasi 70/30 vape juices then you’re going to love this bundle! We’ve bundled together our best-selling Fantasi 70/30 Shortfills so you can save money, whilst stocking up on your favourite E-liquids for no extra cost.
Grape Ice
–
Supremely cooling and mouth-wateringly fruity!
Lemonade Ice
–
Real lemonade flavor, supercooled for the ultimate polar rush! Blue Raspberry-The true-blue gem in the Fantasi Ice collection.
Blue Raspberry x Blueberry Ice –
The true-blue gem in the Fantasi Ice collection blended with succulent, juicy cherries.
Strawberry Ice
–
Fruity, rich strawberries cooled to sub-zero temperatures in what could be our most refreshingly juicy ice flavor so far .
Grape
–
Captures the essence of the exotic grape soda pop in a sweet and fruity e-juice.
Watermelon Ice-
Iced Watermelon soda vape for the ultimate in fruity refreshment.
Mango Ice
–
Make hot summer days a breeze with this icy mango taste sensation!
Orange Ice
–
Enjoy the taste of sweet and juicy ice-cold orange soda any time you like!
Cola Ice
–
Like a can of ice-cold soda straight out of the fridge!
Vape juice is made with a 70/30 mix (70% VG to 30% PG). As VG is thicker than PG, you’ll need a high-powered Sub Ohm device to ensure the e-liquid is vaporised correctly. All of our Fantasi Vape Liquids come in a range of sizes and strengths. You can get your 0mg Fantasi 70/30 vape juice in 120ml Shortfill Bottles.
If you want nicotine with your Shortfills, we stock 100ml and 120ml bottles at either 3mg or 6mg nicotine strength. You can also grab a 10ml E Liquid Bundle with nicotine already added. We stock 10mg and 20mg Nic Salt so you can just pop it into your tank and get vaping straight away!
Ingredients:
Vegetable Glycerine (70%)
Propylene Glycol (30%)
Vapoholic Flavouring
Nicotine Free, Freebase Nicotine, Or Nicotine Salts
What’s in the Bundle?
1x Grape Ice Shortfill
1x Lemonade Ice Shortfill
1x Blue Raspberry Ice Shortfill
1x Blue Raspberry X Cherry Ice Shortfill
1x Strawberry Ice Shortfill
1x Grape Shortfill
1x Watermelon Ice Shortfill
1x Mango Ice Shortfill
1x Orange Ice Shortfill
1x Cola Ice Shortfill
Specifications:
Ratio
70/30
Size
50ml, 60ml, 100ml, 120ml
Nicotine Strength
3mg, 6mg
Flavour
Berry, Citrus, Drinks, Fruit, Grape, Ice Cool, Mango, Menthol, Orange, Raspberry, Strawberry, Tropical, Watermelon
Highlights:
10x our best-selling Fantasi e-liquids for you to try!
Delicious flavours in a 70/30 mix for sub-ohm vaping!
Perfect for cloud-chasing vapers
10 most popular e-liquids bundled together to save you even more money
